product_metadata.title: Modern Littles Laundry Bin, Color Pop Purple Chevron
features: Laundry Storage Basket: storage bin is ideal for keeping dirty laundry separate. This colorful storage bag can help store, move, and hold a multitude of household objects, including children’s toys, books, video games, clothes, and accessories

Design: chevron design pattern printed on the laundry bag looks trendy and can help transform the looks of the interiors where they are placed. Storage basket has 2mm cardboard inserts for keeping the accessories safe
Collapsible and Foldable: purple laundry basket folds flat when not in use for easy storage. Folding facility enables the user to fit these laundry hampers behind the door or under the bed
Portable Basket: 2 metal eyelet handles available in the storage organizer bin enables the user to hold it with ease. Lightweight construction of this storage basket makes it easy to carry

Multi-Utility: laundry basket is an effective storage solution for the laundry room, bedroom and more. Considerable storage capacity of this laundry bin makes it ideal for keeping the rooms well organized
description: Give your messy closets or piles of dirty clothes a separate space for storage using Modern Littles Laundry Basket. This storage hamper enables the user to keep their dirty clothes out of the way and neatly stored. Square shape of the laundry bag offers a small footprint, fitting neatly into any closet, bathroom, or other small space. With its bold hue and easy-to-use design, this storage bin will give any room a fun pop. This portable laundry bin is ideal for keeping clothes, books, toys and more. In addition to use at home, it’s perfect for dorm rooms, apartments, motorhomes, and more. Two side metal eyelets provided in the laundry basket make it easy to carry from place to place. This laundry bag can be easily collapsed and folded flat when not in use which makes it better than other plastic laundry boxes.
